== Course of events ==

With the Queen of the Field Mice having already agreed to guide the travelers toward the Emerald City after an enemy sought to block their path, and with a dozen of her mice concealed within the straw of the Scarecrow's jacket to aid his bid to reclaim his throne from the Army of Revolt, her continued presence and cooperation remained essential to the group. It is at this point that Nick Chopper, the Tin Woodman, blows a silver whistle to summon her.

The Queen answers the call as an old friend, for Nick Chopper had once saved her life, a debt that binds her to him and explains why she comes so readily to his signal. Her appearance at his summons reaffirms the trust between them, set against the backdrop of the journey toward the Emerald City and the mice's hidden mission within the Scarecrow.

Afterward, the travelers continue on their way: the Tin Woodman chops down the Saw-Horse's overlong new leg so the wooden horse can walk more comfortably, and the group at last reaches the gates of the Emerald City, where the Queen of the Field Mice bids them farewell and darts off toward home, her guidance and companionship having carried them safely to their destination.
